name: io.github.sorukumar/tennis-mcp
title: Tennis Analytics MCP
description: Zero-clone ATP tennis analytics: 200k+ matches since 1968, H2H, GSDI, NBI, and shot charting.

environmentVariables.name: TML_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a local tml-data/data directory to bypass HTTPS Parquet caching.

environmentVariables.name: TENNIS_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional cache directory for downloaded Parquet/JSON slices (defaults to ~/.cache/tennis-mcp).
